description: This Java class defines a custom exception, EntityDatatableCheckNotAllowException, which extends the AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException. It is used to signal when a datatable check is not allowed without an associated loan product id, typically when a conflicting check already exists for the entity. The class primarily consists of a constructor that calls the superclass with specific error message parameters.

classes.name: EntityDatatableCheckNotAllowException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a datatable check is not allowed without a loan product id due to existing checks attached to the entity.

methods.name: EntityDatatableCheckNotAllowException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error message indicating the entity involved when a datatable check is not allowed.
